{{Quote|TDC is not fast food, it's fresh food delivered fast!|[[Tasty Dried Critters]] slogan|<ref name="SWG:TDC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Tasty Dried Critters|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Fast food''' was a style of food served at certain restaurants. [[Flangth-2-Go]] was the second-largest fast food restaurant in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="HSSB">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>

[[Tasty Dried Critters]] was a fast food franchise based in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TDC" />
